note: This is where malicious handshake bytes are dispatched into the certificate and key-exchange paths.
When a DHE-based key exchange is selected, the peer public key is passed to the DH derivation layer.
Once the temporary peer key is no longer needed, OpenSSL frees it through the legacy pkey destructor.
The destructor forwards into DH_free for the embedded DH structure.
Reference-count teardown on a stale DH can perform the heap-use-after-free write described by the crash report.
